view.get: what the user is looking at (viewport, selection, focus, window visibility, appearance) exists only in a connected Mac client; easld forwards it (client.attach) and the client-* scenarios replay that through a scripted client
view.render: drawn inline by a connected Mac client. A named browser or singleton browser list goes only to its drawingMachine identity; rectangles and multi-object lists stay on the viewer compositor, including streamed browsers owned elsewhere. easld always asks with inline and no out, so the client writes no file. easld checks the bytes and, unless the caller asked for inline, writes them on the daemon: the caller's out, or a new file under the temp easl-renders directory. Replay through a scripted client
view.snapshot: the board's window as the user sees it: needs the client's window. Forwarded; replayed through a scripted client
agent.prompt: typing only (a target whose integration takes no messages, and the composer): it types into the terminal through the client's live terminal surface (bracketed paste, Return after the paste lands); easld queues `mentions` itself. Forwarded until easld runs zmx sessions; replayed through a scripted client. Out-of-band messages to an integration that takes them (`delivery: "message"`, agent.inbox) are the server's: the messages scenario replays them
agent.restart: kills the tile's zmx session and relaunches it through the client's terminal tile; easld checks the call and refuses it itself (the agent-control scenario replays that). An easld that owns its terminals (--own-terminals) kills and relaunches an owned terminal's session itself (agent-control-owned replays that); the rest is forwarded and replayed through a scripted client
agent.read: the live-terminal modes only (the screen's tail, `lines`, `since: "prompt"`, `block`): they read the terminal through the client's terminal tile (zmx scrollback joined by the live surface's soft-wrap flags; `block` from Ghostty prompt marks), and easld takes them over together with zmx sessions; until then they are forwarded and replayed through a scripted client. `final` (the answer an integration reported, Board.finalAnswers) is the server's: the agents scenario replays it
object.reload: reloads a browser tile's page on its persisted drawingMachine, never the most recently focused viewer. A tile with no drawing Mac, or whose Mac is offline, is unavailable and is not forwarded. Diagrams use an authoritative private object snapshot; the viewer computes with host files and language servers, and easld validates and persists the graph as bookkeeping. Public replies contain only the summary. Scripted clients replay browser reload and a late diagram failure after a zero-timeout wait. Diagram job tests also cover publication, coalescing, deadlines and supersession
object.measure: an html page's exact frame, measured by a connected Mac client that serves object.measure (the page, at the caller's width, with props.root set to the effective link root). With no such client, unavailable, the same as before: an html page is measured by the app. approximate is set only when the client says so. Replay through a scripted client. Other types stay easld's, including text measured from the glyph table
relay.open: easld only, the way back from a hosted terminal's host to the board that shows it (docs/contracts.md "Hosted terminals"); the Mac app answers `unsupported`. easld's own tests (internal/relay) cover it
board.open_remote: the Mac app only: opens another Mac's board in a window, as File › Open Remote… does (docs/contracts.md "Remote boards"), over ssh to a real host; easld has no windows and answers `unsupported`. CanvasCoreTests cover its params and errors
app.update: the Mac app socket only, never delegated by easld. The app answers unavailable without an updater handler; easld preserves its existing invalid_params unknown-method refusal. app-update-validation exercises malformed inputs on either server; app-update-daemon checks easld's refusal of valid modes. Successful check/install and update result fields require the real guest update proof, not replay against a user's app
